exposure: maternal demographic characteristics (age, employment, residence, parity)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 137 mothers admitted to the postnatal ward at Pelonomi Tertiary Hospital in Bloemfontein, South Africa, after a live birth.
finding: 81.0% of fathers were absent at delivery, with employment being the main reason (52.7%), and no association was found between maternal or paternal demographics and father absence.
cross-section timing: During mothers' admission to the postnatal ward after a live birth
